description: Tuatara Embed Stocks: vector embeddings of listed stock symbols and of text in one space, built for the connections a sector label does not carry — which symbols an event, theme or headline moves, including companies it never names. Send sym:TICKER (e.g. sym:AAPL) for a symbol's own vector, or any text (a headline, a theme). With similarity_to_first=true the answer ranks inputs 2..n by cosine to input 1, so 'headline + candidate symbols in, ranked basket out' is one call. 4,096 dimensions, unit length. Up to 64 inputs per call; no account needed; nothing is stored.

encoding_format.description: base64 (default, float32 little-endian) or float (4,096 numbers)

input.description: list of texts to embed: sym:TICKER for a listed symbol's own vector, anything else is embedded as text; at most 64

similarity_to_first.description: also return every other input's cosine to the first input, ranked (e.g. first = the headline, the rest = candidate symbols)

name: stock_vectors
title: Stock Vectors
